source_run_equality_evidence.method: Final owner read of each original public Run compared directly with its saved preflight projection; both equality assertions passed.

limitations: Validation diagnostics only; no quality threshold or physical acceptance is qualified.

evidence.scope: Offline retained-file/receipt review only; no catalog open, model inference, SDK/admission or runtime full-file rehash. Physical/product acceptance remains separate.
evidence.source_run_postcomparison: Owner recorded actual comparison in handoff; duplicate post-comparison Run documents were not retained, so this review does not independently assert that comparison.

isolation.scope: filesystem source/cache absence for this trusted package consumer; no security sandbox claim

sanitization: Allowlisted public identities, data-only inventories, scalar outputs and whole-file evidence hashes. No credentials, private runtime/source configuration, binary arrays, archive or runtime bytes.
scope: Private actual retained canonical A fixed-probe reconstruction; numerical/physical/model-quality/product acceptance remains separate.
